audience: deliverability teams that watch sending domains, email accounts and spam tests in MailReach

useCases.title: Find the weakest sending domain
useCases.text: List the sending domains with their average deliverability score. Read sending and spam statistics for chosen domains.

useCases.title: Check email accounts for blacklist hits
useCases.text: List the connected email accounts with their reputation scores. Read the blacklists that list the sending domain of one account.

useCases.title: Review open notifications and alerts
useCases.text: Count the open notifications by event type, then list those that need attention. List the alert rules too.

useCases.title: Run a spam test and read the result
useCases.text: Create a one-time spam test to get the seedlist recipients. The customer sends the email; the tool does not. Read the result after it arrives.

useCases.title: Review scheduled automated tests
useCases.text: List the scheduled spam tests, optionally only the active ones. Read one test with its schedule and latest result.
